caption_en: Paired RMSE differences across all 18 registered degradation types. Filled markers denote the median external-IEKF minus LegSA-GINS difference over jointly finite cases; open markers denote the 95th percentile, with connecting lines showing the median-to-percentile interval. Each type contains nine registered cases. Negative values favour the IEKF. Both IEKFs diverge in all nine cases for each position-noise type; timestamp-shift cases have no valid common pairs. The symmetric-log axis retains small differences and large excursions. Some velocity, Doppler and heading faults act on channels not read by an external filter; these are input-equivalence controls rather than independent robustness demonstrations. Full type definitions, all 396 logical results and all 744 paired summaries accompany the figure.
caption_zh: 全部18种登记退化类型的配对RMSE差。实心点为共同有限样本中“外部IEKF减LegSA-GINS”的中位数，空心点为95百分位，连线表示二者之间的区间；每种退化登记九个案例。负值表示IEKF误差较低。两种位置噪声下，两种IEKF均各9/9发散；时间戳扰动无有效共同配对。对称对数轴同时保留小差值和大偏离。部分速度、多普勒及航向故障作用于外部滤波器未读取的通道，属于输入等价控制。完整类型定义、396条逻辑结果和744条配对汇总随图交付。
meaning_zh: 这张补充图保留所有故障类别和反例；它逐类比较，不把异质故障混成一个总排名。
